items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and continue only the existing period-aligned reconciliation. Amazon reports $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21 from 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items; the income is in aggregate tracking_id=other and cannot support site revenue claims. AI spend is $916.914544 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28 across 5,009 calls and 39 instrumented sites, but matching-period infrastructure, labor, domain, marketing, commitments, and budget costs are unavailable. Contribution margin, cost-to-learn, payback, ROI, budget exposure, forecasts, and causal lift are therefore not calculable. Do not treat missing data as zero or use 14,410 impressions, 146 clicks, 1,002 sessions, 15 conversions, or 3 proven outcomes as financial evidence. Minimum finance artifact: reconcile provider/site/content identifiers, revenue, AI and infrastructure costs, other operating costs, commitments, budget ceilings, and an approved learning threshold for the same period. No new proposals, change requests, requeues, deployments, telemetry, spending, or monetization changes.

Known finance boundaries: site-level revenue is unsupported because Amazon supplied one unattributed aggregate income row; contribution margin is not calculable because matching-period operating and infrastructure costs are missing; cost-to-learn is not calculable because no approved learning threshold or complete incremental-cost ledger exists; budget exposure is not calculable because monthly spend limit, fixed costs, marketing budget, revenue target, and revenue floor are blank. Retain the $4.92 as unattributed and preserve all unavailable financial fields as unknown.
